role: Exact singleton and relation-aware complete-law cost prerequisite for all 51 untested L=2 supports and three replay controls
question: Can all remaining same-first-flux winding supports be covered by a future complete-second-public-law matrix within inherited ideal-orbit caps?

hypotheses.affordable: All 51 candidates and three controls pass one-site and variable-site gates and their combined projected complete-law cost fits the inherited caps.
hypotheses.cost_censored: A variable-site or combined structural cost gate fails; no all-support complete-law inference is released.

source_basis: R6AF remediated public charge and J6L/J6M L=2 ideal orbit
J8C exhaustive 54 eight-edge supports and positive first masses
J8D three representative exact second-law controls
J8B signed-projector and Walsh reconstruction method
fork_classification: All 51 remaining supports are independent reversible diagnostics under the same fixed first record and both actions. Traverse all in J8C order; do not ask a human to rank or select by outcomes. Three J8D representatives replay. An affordable cost result gates a separate full-law registration; cap censoring calls for deterministic batches within the same authorized total budget.
frozen_model: Same R6AF IID red-X physical channel at p_Z=0 and ideal periodic L=2 D4 orbit. Each private error preserves the selected full-binary all-zero first charge record and common first flux at its own positive exact mass. The public actions are [0] and [1,30,32,34,35]. Only hidden initial support changes; no new fault, geometry, posterior prior, logical score, noisy round or schedule policy is introduced.

matrix.design: Traverse every J8C eight-edge row not selected by J8D, then all three J8D controls, under both actions. Verify first mass by exact orbit expansion, compute each of 22 second-site one-bit expectations, and record variable sites. For pair/higher groups of at most five variable sites, classify first-projector anticommutation, signed relation, or needed orbit expansion without evaluating higher-order expectations. Sum projected full-law orbit and relation costs. No complete law is reconstructed.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact private error/selected-first-record/action structural cost cell; no sampling unit or interval.
matrix.integrity: Hash-pin inputs and runner before/after; verify exactly 51 new plus three distinct controls, first masses, common full first and second flux, all 22 second sites, operator commutation, exact singleton means in {-1,0,+1}, and J8D control variable-site replay. Any incomplete prefix remains explicitly censored.

acceptance: All 51 untested supports and three controls represented under both actions, or exact cap-censored prefix and unresolved remainder
All completed cells audit 22 exact singleton expectations and J8D control variable sites replay
Project relation-aware complete-law cost without any higher-order expectation or second law
Declare future all-support affordability only if all variable-site and combined orbit/relation gates pass
No full-IID information, class-wide law, logical-risk, noisy-JIT, L=3 or threshold claim

outcomes.affordable: Separately register the full 54-support second-law matrix within the same inherited cap; cost alone is not a law result.
outcomes.cost_censored: Preserve failing site or cost gate and design fixed nonselective batches within the unchanged total authorized budget.
outcomes.runtime_censored: Preserve completed prefix, gate and unresolved remainder; no full-matrix affordability claim.

stop_rule: Stop after 54 support rows and 108 action cells or first CPU/orbit/relation cap. No complete second law, higher-order parity expectation, posterior, logical score, history, arm or bootstrap.
